source_image_review: Root inspected both original image files; an independent agent also inspected them.
The V6 plate contains nine storeys, the full base and finial, 0-147m scale, 133.77m pan-bottom endpoint, and explicit research limitations.

The V15 tower has nine visible wall-body storeys and corresponds to the V6 colour selection. Eleven finial discs are not independently countable in the small panorama; their count is supported by native source components.
The panorama tower has a flatter rendering style than the painted background; eave articulation is weaker at panorama scale. The review does not establish perfect painterly integration.
147m remains a design scenario and overall structural feasibility is not established.
